verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
From the highest of heights
To the depths of the sea

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
From the colors of fall to the fragrance of spring
Every creature unique in the song that it sings
All exclaiming

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
You placed the stars in the sky and You know them by name
You are amazing God

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
Awestruck we fall to our knees as we humbly proclaim
You are amazing God

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines: Who has told every lightning bolt where it should go

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: Or seen heavenly storehouses laden with snow

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
Who imagined the sun
And gives source to its light

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
Yet conceals it to bring us the coolness of night
None can fathom

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
You placed the stars in the sky and You know them by name
You are amazing God

verse.name: c2c
verse.lines:
Incomparable, unchangeable
You see the depths of my heart and You love me the same

verse.name: c2d
verse.lines:
You are amazing God
You are amazing God
